regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “IN THE FRESCO-2 STUDY FRUZAQLA HELPED PRESERVE CERTAIN QUALITY OF LIFE MEASURES” | “A quality of life survey taken as part of the study showed more than 70% of people living with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) taking FRUZAQLA + BSC reported their symptoms staying the same or taking longer to get worse compared with people taking placebo + BSC.” | “Symptoms that took longer to get worse with FRUZAQLA + BSC vs placebo + BSC: o Emotional health o Social well-being o Tiredness (fatigue) o Nausea/vomiting o Trouble sleeping (insomnia)”
cases.context: FRESCO-2 QLQ-C30/EQ-5D-5L secondary endpoints with no alpha allocation; attrition (esp. placebo); 7-day recall aligned to off-treatment days; confounding; time-to-deterioration ignores discontinuers. Disclaimer present.
cases.rationale: PRO data exploratory; cannot support QoL benefit or between-arm comparisons; disclaimer does not cure.
cases.check: Rule: flag QoL/PRO claims where the PRO endpoint lacked alpha allocation/multiplicity control; judgment for PRO design flaws (recall window, attrition).
